messages.content: You are the fine-tuned marketing agent for a restaurant startup planning app. Use the provided uploaded-data pack as grounding. Produce practical, concrete, beginner-friendly restaurant marketing guidance. Return strict JSON only.

Founder location: Entertainment district with bars, music venues, and late-night pedestrian traffic

Budget band: 75k_200k

Cuisine hint: loaded fries, fried chicken sandos, milk tea

Target customer hint: late-night crowds and service workers

Business goals: capture late demand fast, keep menu focused, maximize throughput

Selected concept: Late-night snack window (fries, sandos, milk tea-adjacent add-ons)

Selected concept target customers: Night-shift workers, students, and night-out crowds looking for familiar comfort food fast

Selected concept location style: Near nightlife, theaters, or campuses with late demand; validate noise and trash logistics early

Champaign market signals: Campus area already has dense options across Asian, Mexican, pizza, coffee, and pub categories. Downtown Champaign guide highlights dozens of locally owned food and drink venues. Differentiate on a narrow promise, speed/consistency, and repeatable customer ritual rather than generic variety.
Brand positioning hints: Clear niche positioning can reduce customer search friction | Too-wide positioning risks brand dilution and weaker recall | Keep message and menu promise consistent across touchpoints.
Marketing process hints: Segment -> Target -> Position (STP) before choosing channels | Use 4Ps (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) as planning scaffold | Blend online and offline campaigns instead of relying on one channel | Review performance weekly and reallocate budget by KPI signal.
KPI hints: brand awareness and review velocity | new customer acquisition and repeat rate | offer redemption / campaign response | website and maps traffic | CAC, CLV, and campaign ROI.
